title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1969-11-08
lineage: MR (Dick Latvala) > DAT > SoundForge (Jim Wise) > CD

ai_review.summary: Soundboard source captures a solid ’69 Dead show with a notable Uncle John’s Band/Main Ten jam and decent overall audio quality.
ai_review.review: The recording is a sound‑board capture that sounds clear enough for the era, though it omits part of the China Cat > Rider sequence. Musically the concert sits in the middle of the 1969 spectrum – first set average but the second half delivers tight jams, especially the rare Main Ten and an engaging Uncle John’s Band.

ai_rating.rationale: Two enthusiastic 5‑star reviews praise key songs and overall performance, while one detailed 3‑star review notes an average first set and some missing material; recording quality is generally good but not flawless.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear SBD tape with typical vintage warmth; no major dropouts mentioned, though the release is completed from Dick's 16 and lacks the full Rider jam, making it slightly incomplete.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is described as average and tentative, while the second half ramps up with tighter jamming, a rare Main Ten, and strong transitions between China Cat and Rider.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Noted for early phrasing on Dire Wolf and an unfinished Mama Tried arrangement; guitar work described as tentative but promising.
band_member_comments.Drums: Good Lovin' features a drum solo; overall rhythm section is solid though not highlighted beyond that.
